description.narrative: Syftet med programmet är att ytterligare stödja decentraliseringsprocessen i Ukraina genom ett långsiktigt fokus på att åtgärda inkonsekvenserna i Ukrainas lokala självstyresystem och flernivåstyre och samtidigt stärka kommunernas tillhandahållande av offentliga tjänster, samt deras direkta engagemang i återhämtnings- och återuppbyggnadsprocessen, i linje med kraven för EU-anslutning.

The aim of the programme is to support further the decentralization process in Ukraine through a long term focus on addressing the inconsistencies in Ukraine's local self-government framework and system of multi-level governance and in parallel strengthening municipalities' public service provision, as well as their direct engagement in the recovery and reconstruction process, in line with the requirements of EU accession.

The proposed programme aims to address the inconsistencies in Ukraine's local self government (LSG) framework and system of multilevel governance while strengthening municipalities public service provision, as well as their direct engagement in the recovery and reconstruction process, in line with the requirements of EU integration. To address urgent needs caused by the war, while simultaneously building long term capacities and consolidating and strengthening the decentralisation process in Ukraine, the project is designed as a two-component programme, covering five thematic areas in which Sweden and SALAR has unique experience and credibility in Ukraine.
Component 1: Multilevel governance and policy
Component 2: Enhancing the capacity of municipalities
Thematic Areas: Education, Administrative Service Provision, Fiscal Decentralisation, Locally Led Recovery and International Municipal Cooperation.
